{{Quote|Echo Station 3-T-8. We have spotted Imperial walkers.|[[Trey Callum]], shortly before the Battle of Hoth|<ref name="ESB" />}}
'''Echo Station 3-T-8''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[scout]] post outside [[Echo Base]] on the icy [[planet]] [[Hoth]]. Prior to the [[Battle of Hoth]], scouts at the [[Echo Station]] were the first to spot approaching [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] forces. After sighting Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport|AT-ATs]] on the north ridge, the station [[officer]] relayed the message to the rest of Echo Base. The post, which was garrisoned by multiple [[Rebel trooper|Rebel troops]] and [[turret]]s, was quickly overwhelmed by the advancing Imperial forces.

==Description==
Located on the frozen, barren [[planet]] [[Hoth]], Echo Station 3-T-8 was composed of [[Trench warfare|trenches]] dug out along the [[North Ridge]] near [[Echo Base]]. The station was used for [[scout]]ing purposes, and it was occupied by several [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] [[Rebel trooper|troops]] and [[turret]]s.<ref name="ESB" />

==History==
Early in the [[Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] base made its home in the [[Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4]]. The [[Galactic Empire|Empire]] tracked the Rebels to Yavin 4 and attempted to destroy the [[moon]] with the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], a [[superweapon]] capable of destroying [[planet]]s. During the ensuing [[Battle of Yavin|battle]], [[Rebel pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker]] successfully destroyed the [[space station]]. Although the Death Star was destroyed, Rebel forces [[Evacuation of Yavin 4|evacuated]], as the Empire knew their location.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

Following the evacuation of [[Yavin Prime|Yavin]], [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]] initiated a search for a new base,<ref name="PL1">[[Princess Leia 1|''Princess Leia'' 1]]</ref> and within three [[Standard year|years]] Echo Base was constructed on Hoth, accompanied by a [[V-150 Planet Defender|v-150 ion cannon]] and several outposts, such as Echo Station 3-T-8.<ref name="GD">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Defense]]''</ref>

Three years after the Battle of Yavin, [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military|forces]] located Echo Base in the [[Hoth system]] during [[Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Vader's]] search for Luke Skywalker. Led by General [[Maximilian Veers]], Imperial [[Imperial Army|ground forces]] consisting of [[All Terrain Armored Transport|AT-ATs]], [[All Terrain Scout Transport|AT-STs]], and [[Cold weather assault trooper|snowtroopers]] were deployed at the [[Moorsh Moraine]] and began their approach toward the Rebel base.<ref name="GD" />

Rebel scouts at Station 3-T-8 were the first to spot the oncoming forces, and immediately notified Echo Base. Echo Station 3-T-8's forces stood no match to the firepower of the Imperial [[walker]]s, and the Rebel [[soldier]]s stationed there became the first [[Death|victims]] in the Empire's tremendous victory.<ref name="GD" />
